narr: A surface low meandered offshore of the NE FL coastal along a stalled front. Passing upper-level short wave trough energy, high moisture and slow storm motion produced locally heavy rainfall and pulse strong storms with wet downbursts in resultant storms. Storms impacted coastal areas in the morning, then with diurnal heating shift inland.
ev: At 3:51 am, law enforcement reported that heavy rainfall caused flooding in the Atlantic Beach area, closing part of Mayport Road (1800 to 1900 block) and all of Atlantic Boulevard (300 block) from 3rd Street to Ocean Boulevard. At 3:50 am, broadcast media shared photos showing extensive road flooding along Palm Ave and Aquatic Dr in Atlantic Beach. Time was estimated by nearby report. Some locations in the Flash Flood Warning area measured 3-6 inches of rainfall during the early morning.
